categories.main_business_segments: Yamada Consulting Group operates two main business segments: Consulting and Investment. The Consulting segment includes management consulting, M&A advisory, business succession consulting, and real estate consulting. The Investment segment covers unlisted equity investments and real estate investment activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core capabilities lie in its expertise in management consulting, financial and tax advisory, M&A execution, and real estate solutions. It leverages a cross-functional team of professionals with accounting, legal, and financial backgrounds, and utilizes data analysis, digital transformation (DX), and structured project management methodologies to deliver its services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yamada Consulting Group primarily serves mid-sized and large enterprises, owner-managed businesses, and high-net-worth individuals. Its key markets include companies facing management, succession, restructuring, or growth challenges, as well as clients seeking M&A or real estate solutions. The group also supports Japanese companies expanding overseas and foreign companies entering Japan or Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Tokyo and has a strong domestic presence with offices in major Japanese cities. Internationally, it operates subsidiaries and affiliates in Singapore, China (Shanghai), Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, India, and the United States (Los Angeles), with a particular focus on Asia and North America for cross-border M&A and consulting.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yamada Consulting Group operates as a downstream service provider, delivering high-value-added consulting and investment solutions directly to end clients. In the investment business, it acts as a midstream player by providing capital and management support to unlisted companies and real estate assets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The group’s strategic focus is on maximizing customer lifetime value through comprehensive, cross-segment consulting and investment services. Key priorities include strengthening its position in mid-sized enterprise consulting, expanding cross-border M&A capabilities (especially in the US and Asia), enhancing digital transformation and productivity, and developing human capital. There is no traditional R&D, but ongoing investment in talent development, digital tools, and cross-border expertise.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through fee-based consulting services, success fees for M&A advisory, and commissions from real estate transactions. The investment segment earns returns from capital gains on unlisted equity and real estate investments. The company also receives recurring fees from ongoing advisory and support contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include major Japanese and global consulting firms, specialized M&A advisory boutiques, and real estate advisory companies. Yamada Consulting Group differentiates itself as a comprehensive, independent consulting and investment group with strong expertise in mid-sized company support, business succession, and cross-border M&A, particularly between Japan, Asia, and the US.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 22.8 billion yen, with operating profit of 4.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of 2.88 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in both revenue and profit, with a significant increase in consulting business sales and stable profitability. Total assets stand at 23.5 billion yen, and the group employs over 1,000 people.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yamada Consulting Group emphasizes its ability to provide one-stop, high-quality solutions across management, M&A, succession, and real estate, leveraging deep expertise in finance, tax, and law. Its unique value lies in long-term client partnerships, cross-segment collaboration, and a strong track record in supporting mid-sized companies and cross-border transactions, especially for Japanese clients expanding globally.
